46-JAIL ROAD LAHORE-54000
Dated: 17th June-2026 Time: 11:45 hours (PST)

DAILY FLOOD BULLETIN

RIVERS SITUATION AND QUALITATIVE FLOOD FORECAST

 

I:    HYDROLOGICAL SITUATION at 0600 PST AND OUTLOOK            

  • All the major rivers are flowing within their normal flows.

  • Moderate rainfall is expected over DG khan & Rajanpur, consequently flows may increase in hill torrents of these districts during next 24 hours. 

     II:   METEOROLOGICAL FEATURES  

  1. A trough of westerly wave is persisting over upper and central parts of the country. 

  2. Moist currents from the Arabian Sea are penetrating into the southern and central parts of the country up to 3000ft.

  3. Seasonal low lies over North Balochistan. 

III: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 24-HOURS

Moderate rain/wind-thunderstorm is likely at Scattered places over the upper catchments of the Indus, Jhelum, and Chenab rivers, along with Islamabad, all districts of Kashmir, in KPK, Swat, Shangla, Buner, Bajaur, Abbottabad, Haripur, Mardan, Swabi, Charsadda, Peshawar, Nowshera, Khyber, Mohmand, Kohat, Hangu, Karak, Orakzai, Kurram, Bannu, Lakki Marwat, North Waziristan, Dera Ismail Khan, Tank, South Waziristan. In Punjab, Attock, Rawalpindi, Jhelum, Chakwal, Gujranwala, Hafizabad, Gujrat, Mandi Bahauddin, Sialkot, Narowal, Vehari, Multan, Lodhran, Khanewal, Dera Ghazi Khan, Rajanpur, Layyah, Muzaffargarh, Bahawalpur, Bahawalnagar.

Moderate rain-thunderstorms at Isolated places are also likely all districts of Gilgit Baltistan, in Upper KPK Chitral, Lower Chitral, Upper Dir, Lower Dir. In Punjab, Lahore, Kasur, Sheikhupura, Nankana Sahib, Sahiwal, Okara, Faisalabad, Jhang, Chiniot, Toba Tek Singh, Pakpattan, Rahim yar khan, Sargodha, Bhakkar, Khushab, Mianwali. In Sindh, Ghotki, Sukkur, Khairpur, Shikarpur, Larkana, and in Balochistan Quetta, Zhob, Kalat, Mustang, and Khuzdar.

Moderate rain/wind-thunderstorm is likely at Scattered places over the upper catchments of the Indus, and Jhelum rivers, along with Islamabad, all districts of Kashmir, in KPK, Swat, Shangla, Buner, Bajaur, Abbottabad, Haripur, Mardan, Swabi, Charsadda, Peshawar, Nowshera, Khyber, Mohmand, Kohat, Hangu, Karak, Orakzai, Kurram, Bannu, Lakki Marwat, North Waziristan, Dera Ismail Khan, Tank, South Waziristan. Moderate rain-thunderstorms at Isolated places are also likely all districts of Gilgit Baltistan, in Upper KPK Chitral, Lower Chitral, Upper Dir, Lower Dir.
